title.zh: Here’s what’s new in the final CLARITY Act before Tuesday’s Senate vote
title.en: Here’s what’s new in the final CLARITY Act before Tuesday’s Senate vote

current_state.zh: Senate Republicans released a final CLARITY Act draft incorporating 126 Democratic-requested changes on ethics, stablecoin risk, developer protections, market conflicts, consumer safeguards, and AML rules, setting up a Tuesday cloture vote.
current_state.en: Senate Republicans released a final CLARITY Act draft incorporating 126 Democratic-requested changes on ethics, stablecoin risk, developer protections, market conflicts, consumer safeguards, and AML rules, setting up a Tuesday cloture vote.
